title: Feature request : Omnipod / no pod beeps at night or for x hours
body:
@Avereha It would be very nice if one could silence pod beeps for x hours and/or if phone is in _Do not disturb_ mode.

The pod alerts for _y hours before pod end_ , or _less than z units left_ etc are not life threatening and should be silenceable at specific moments like in a reunion or at night. 

I prefer sleeping than being woken up by a beeping pod because there is 20U insulin left or that the 72h pod life will arrive in 2 hours.

These beeps can de manually deactivated in the pod settings but it is not practical to do it each night and there is a risk of forgetting to put them back on in the morning.
